text:
liz: quick heads-up — change window tonight 23:00 UTC. planning a docstore schema tweak + model pin. please ack if you need a hard freeze exemption.

deploy-bot: scheduled change window 'midnight-slice' created for 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-23T01:00:00Z. owners: @liz, @sam.

sam: ack. I have the rollout plan in the release doc (links/files). I’ll be watching rollout metrics and error budgets.

maya: can we confirm the rollback command and pin procedure one more time? last time it was fuzzy.

jorge: rollback is `./scripts/rollback.sh --to-tag v3.2.0` from ops-runner host. pin/unpin is via deploy-bot: `deploy-bot pin service/docstore v3.2.1` and `deploy-bot unpin service/docstore`.

alex: +1 on jorge's commands. also recommend enabling the emergency traffic-shed route before the schema swap: `route set --service docstore --mode read-only --duration 10m` on ops console.

liz: good. sam do you want the canary cadence?

sam: yes — 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 10m per step, manual proceed. will abort if 5xx > 1% or p95 latency +200ms from baseline.

maya: also, devs want a short maintenance notice for the SDK clients. schedule message at T-30m?

liz: send it at T-15m instead; ops prefers shorter notice for this change. I’ll draft.

deploy-bot: pin request received: `pin service/docstore v3.2.1` by liz. Current pin state: PENDING. Reply `confirm` to apply.

liz: confirm

deploy-bot: pin applied: service/docstore -> v3.2.1. Audit: liz @ 3180009999.

ops-bot: preflight smoke checks — all green except one worker in eu-west that shows stale container image (will be restarted during warmup).

sam: note: warmup plan will restart that worker during canary 5% -> warmup before traffic. added a note in release doc.

jorge: quick rollback snippet I'll paste to #runbooks: ```
# fast rollback
ssh ops-runner
./scripts/rollback.sh --to-tag v3.2.0
deploy-bot unpin service/docstore
```

maya: thanks — can we have a post-launch check list for the first 30m? I added items: DB index health, KV cache hitrate, p50/p95 latency, error budget burn, and anomalies on APM traces.

alex: one more: validate that the quantization profile for the new model variant didn't accidentally get applied to hosted customers in the canary. check model-routing logs.

liz: final callouts: 1) no code pushes to docstore after T-60m 2) public release notes go out at T+30m if all good 3) emergency unpin owner = jorge.

sam: got it. I'll post the T-15m maintenance blurb and pin the silent pager for the window.

maya: ack.

jorge: ack and standing by for rollback.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled in 45m: 'midnight-slice' starts in 45 minutes.

liz: thanks team. keep chat here during the window, use #release-war-room for cross-org updates. :thumbsup:
